messages:
Jenna: Hi team  just unpacked my new hire kit and the monitor arrived but the bracket doesn't match my VESA holes. The monitor came with a 100x100 plate but the arm in the kit uses 75x75. Packing slip number: 7X-NEWHIRE-19. Anyone know if we have an adapter or the right arm?

oliver_it: Welcome Jenna! Sorry about that. Quick Q: is the arm labeled "FlexArm-75" or similar? If it's a FlexArm-75 we can swap for a FlexArm-100 or ship a 75-to-100 adapter.

Jenna: The arm tag says "FlexArm-Pro" but the plate on the monitor is definitely 100x100. I can live with drilling but prefer the right hardware :grimacing:.

it-bot: New IT/facilities ticket created: #45678 "Monitor VESA mismatch - FlexArm/Plate" assigned to marta-facilities.

marta-facilities: Hey @Jenna, we have adapters in SF and NY stock. Are you SF-based or remote? If SF, drop by front desk and ask for "VESA-ADPT-JENNA" and they'll hand it to you. If remote, I'll ship priority with a prepaid return label for the incorrect arm.

Jenna: I'm remote in Denver. Could you ship? Also small question: the monitor stand screws seem T8 Torx. Do you include a driver bit in the kits?

marta-facilities: Shipping arranged. We'll include the 75->100 adapter and a small Torx bit in the package. ETA 2 business days. Please keep the original arm and packing material until we confirm swap.

oliver_it: For future kits, thanks for flagging. @marta-facilities can you note this packing slip mismatch so we don't send FlexArm-Pro with 100x100 monitors? I've also added a small doc note in the new-hire checklist.

Jenna: Appreciate it. One tiny follow-up  the monitor has a faint vertical line near the left edge when displaying light backgrounds. Should I still keep and we can test after adapter swap, or do you want me to request a replacement?

marta-facilities: Keep it for now and we'll evaluate after the adapter install. If the line persists, we'll send a replacement monitor. Please snap a quick photo and attach to the ticket if it still shows after swap.

Jenna: Will do. Thanks everyone ":thumbsup:"
